array.string: set -a; source /Users/daniildegtyarev/.config/roehub/roehub.env; set +a; if [[ -n "${POSTGRES_EXPORTER_DSN:-}" ]]; then export DATA_SOURCE_NAME="$POSTGRES_EXPORTER_DSN"; else export DATA_SOURCE_URI="127.0.0.1:5432/${POSTGRES_DB}?sslmode=disable"; export DATA_SOURCE_USER="${POSTGRES_USER}"; export DATA_SOURCE_PASS="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"; fi; exec /opt/roehub/bin/postgres_exporter --web.listen-address=127.0.0.1:9187
